TRAIN WINDOW STUDIO · SCENE 05
Halloween Village at Dusk
Glowing pumpkins. Victorian porches. The last violet light of October.

Your window seat

Settle in. Make the ride your own.

Journey & passing events

Five minutes per scene at normal speed. Tunnels connect each scene and close the full journey loop.

Land → tunnel → river bridge → tunnel → land. Both river tunnels are included with the crossing.

Station stops ease to a 16-second pause at normal speed. Train sounds follow the stops and tunnels.

Cabin & view

Video size and frame rate are set separately.

Changing modes reloads the app. Save your setup as a favorite first.

Close to the glass ← → More of the carriage

Near scenery blurs with speed. Reflections follow the carriage and show through most clearly at night.

Weather

A slow passing shower that returns to its starting conditions. The rain slider sets its peak.

Snow falls between the scenery layers. Wind direction and gusts also shape the snowfall.

Fine beads collect into rivulets, clearing paths through the mist. Tunnels shelter the glass from fresh rain. Sideways drift eases to a stop at stations and builds as the train pulls away.

Sound & music

Sound starts when you enable it.

Generated train ambience · Recorded rain. Rain sound and rain on the glass can be adjusted independently.

No music loaded · choose an MP3, WAV, M4A, or OGG.

Imported music stays on this device for this session. Short tracks get a gentle join when looping.

Video export

Long videos repeat the scenery seamlessly while your soundtrack continues. Fixed durations stay the same at every travel speed. 60 FPS gives smoother motion and larger files.

Video + optional stereo audio · 30 or 60 FPS · WebM
Runs in your browser. Your music stays on your device. Space: pause · H: cinema · F: fullscreen.

The complete scene repeats after 5 minutes. Nearby textures recur within the longer journey.

Favorites & export queue

Favorites save on this browser. Back them up to carry them to another device or app copy. Music files stay in the current session.

Each item remembers its scene, controls, mixer, current music, and video size, frame rate, and length.
